verdict.rationale: Gitea's marketing page lists "SAML SSO Integration" as a product feature, so SAML SSO support is a first-party claim. Nothing in the evidence shows how it works, or that an admin can enforce SAML as mandatory for an organization rather than just offer it as a login option. Community mentions of OAuth2 and OIDC are a different protocol and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of the SAML configuration, the ability to require or enforce SAML login per organization (blocking other login methods), clarity on which edition or tier includes it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can require SAML single sign-on for my organization
